text: Do not use words like robust, seamless, leverage, comprehensive, utilize, streamline, crucial or delve in comments.
Do not start comments with "This function", "This method" or "This class". Say what is not obvious from the code, or write nothing.
Do not write doc comments on private functions and properties.
No generic names like handleData, processItem, result2 or helper. Name the thing after what it is.
Do not wrap code in try/catch defensively. Let errors propagate unless there is a specific recovery.
Do not use !! to force-unwrap nullable values.
Do not use the ! non-null assertion. Narrow the type or handle the undefined case.
Do not use any. Type the value or use unknown.
Do not use a bare except. Catch the exception you expect.
Do not panic. Return the error.
Use the two-value form of type assertions, v, ok := x.(T), so a wrong type does not panic.
